items.raw_excerpt: Server outage leaves passport applicants frustrated in multiple cities, with no official updates on service disruptions.
items.summary_en: A server outage has frustrated passport applicants in several Indian cities. There are no official updates about the service disruption. People are waiting without knowing when the service will return.

items.raw_excerpt: We had a good number of riders all taking advantage of the earlier start and the cooler weather.

items.raw_excerpt: A three-day weekend in Cygnet offers Huon Valley scenery, local arts, apple orchards, and relaxed lodging in one of Tasmania’s most livable towns.
items.summary_en: Cygnet is a small town in Tasmania. A three-day visit brings Huon Valley views, local art, and apple orchards. It is one of the most livable small towns in Tasmania.
items.summary_ko: 시그넷은 태즈메이니아의 작은 마을입니다. 3일 동안 휴언 계곡의 풍경과 지역 예술, 사과 과수원을 즐길 수 있습니다. 태즈메이니아에서 가장 살기 좋은 마을 중 하나로 꼽힙니다.
items.title_en: A Cozy 3-Day Weekend in Cygnet, Tasmania

items.summary_en: An Irish coin could be worth far more than its face value. Galway residents should check the coins in their pockets or wallet for the valuable euro.

items.raw_excerpt: Like the stylish Cadaqués, Port Issac in Cornwall is much more than just a sleepy fishing village
items.summary_en: Port Isaac is a small fishing village in Cornwall with an artistic feel. Like Cadaques in Catalonia, it has beautiful coastal views, a harbor, and brilliant seafood. Travel writers call it Cornwall's answer to the Spanish seaside town.

items.title_en: Is this Cornwall's answer to Spain's Cadaques?
